title: Password field displayed as plain text
description:
Security rule — a password / PIN field is shown on a layout by an object that is not a concealed edit box, so the value is rendered in clear text. Listed per layout object (the same field can be exposed on several layouts).

Complements the storage-level rule (password_field_plaintext): here the concern is the on-screen rendering, which is decided at the layout-object level, not on the field.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A secret shown in a plain edit box is readable over the shoulder, in screenshots and screen shares — the field is never masked.
rule.remediation: Set the field object to a concealed edit box (verschlüsseltes Bearbeitungsfeld), or do not place the secret on a layout at all.
